journeys.name: core-cli
journeys.note: Daemon plus CLI over the real transport: status, auth, sessions, PTY and crash recovery (18 checks, ~10s).

journeys.name: bot-monitors
journeys.note: SKIPPED: a Bot's own monitor and automation act end to end; needs real pi/dgx-spark inference plus two minute-scale scheduler ticks, unavailable under the no-real-inference rule on this host.

journeys.name: bot-graph-sidebar
journeys.note: Graph sidebar renders the live main beside workers, contact loss reads unverifiable, recovery preserves collapse; zero harness start/stop side effects.

journeys.name: bot-open-session-focus
journeys.note: With a Bot session already open, Open session focuses it instead of dispatching a duplicate; repeated clicks keep one conversation.

journeys.name: bot-session-resume
journeys.note: First-click focus lands on the live Bot session, a closed session resumes through the harness --continue path, and the Chats row shows the agent avatar and name.

journeys.name: sidebar-agent-tree
journeys.note: An agent spawned in a shell nests three levels deep in the sidebar, collapse persists across reload, and the root row reads the agent, not the shell.

journeys.name: subagent-tab-groups
journeys.note: Fan-out subagents group under their leader, one click folds the group, typed input reaches only the leader while folded, and the fold survives reload.

journeys.name: preload-close-guard
journeys.note: Main-world window.close guard is installed, non-native, and irreversible over live CDP against the dev build (DROGON_BACKGROUND_WINDOW=1, disposable data dir).

journeys.name: backup-restore
journeys.note: Pre-migration backup restore against a locally packaged ad-hoc bundle (node scripts/package-desktop.mjs): lock refusal, restore overlay light/dark, confirmation gate, relaunch healthy, CLI restore. All owned processes verified exited.

journeys.name: orchestration-e2e
journeys.note: Fixture pi drives the real daemon end to end: default policy dispatch, exact provider/model propagation, durable worker_done with result metadata, retry failover, ask/resume, and outcome-less exit discipline.

journeys.name: orchestrator
journeys.note: Orchestrator canvas on the real app over CDP: honest disabled state, live Main agent node, delegate brief write-through, Agent telemetry/Usage ledgers, and a real durable run that stops without fabricating success.

journeys.name: orchestrator-modes
journeys.note: SKIPPED: the three execution modes drive the real pi harness on the cheap model; needs real model inference, forbidden from validation on this host.

journeys.name: durable-orchestrator
journeys.note: Work Graph roles run as native sessions on fixture harnesses: main-only pass, findings-review-retest loop, fallback exhaustion, and reload without duplicate launches.

journeys.name: live-child-crash
journeys.note: A provably live PTY child survives daemon SIGKILL: the restarted daemon labels the prior-live session unverifiable, renews identity, refuses respawn, and replays the historic receipt verbatim.

journeys.name: cli-worktree-lineage
journeys.note: A worktree created by drogon-cli inside a session nests under that session's worktree in the sidebar; nesting survives reload and no-parent stays top-level.

journeys.name: worker-settle-releases-pty
journeys.note: A worker that reports worker_done but keeps running reads succeeded-but-live; worker-stop refuses attempt_settled without signalling, and worker-release reaps the PTY so none stays live.

One software-rendering round (DROGON_SOFTWARE_RENDERING) attempted in the fourth pass; re-add the manifest entry once a CI run proves the stall fixed. The screenshot-budget guard (scripts/check-screenshot-budget.mjs) keeps the 120s budgets pinned until then.
